# EDS214 Final Project: Figure Reproducibility

## Background

The following is the final project analysis for EDS214. The main goal for this project was to replicate Figure 3 from Schaefer et al. (2000) through the implementation of coding techniques learned in this class, including code automation, organization, documentation, and collaboration methods. Figure 1 below shows Figure 3 with the corresponding figure caption from the original Schaefer et al. (2000) publication.

```{r} 
# Load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(reprex)
library(ggh4x)
# Qmd RENDER source
source("../R/moving-average.R")
# POSITRON CONSOLE source
# source(here::here("R/moving-average.R"))
```

![Schaefer et al. (2000) Figure 3](here::here(figs/Schaefer_etal_2000_Figure3.png))

Figure 1: The original Figure 3 from Schaefer et al. (2000) depicting the concentrations of 5 measured ions - K, NO~3~-N, Mg, Ca, and NH~4~-H - across 4 stream sites in Puerto Rico.

## Methods

For each site data set, the moving average was calculated across a 9 week measurement window for each of the five ions. These moving averages were then plotted in a line graph

```{r}
# Call moving average function from R/ for each of the 4 data df
sm_Q1_Bisley_data <- moving_average(Q1_Bisley_data)
sm_Q1_Bisley_data <- sm_Q1_Bisley_data |> mutate(Site_ID = "BQ1")
sm_Q2_Bisley_data <- moving_average(Q2_Bisley_data)
sm_Q2_Bisley_data <- sm_Q2_Bisley_data |> mutate(Site_ID = "BQ2")
sm_Q3_Bisley_data <- moving_average(Q3_Bisley_data)
sm_Q3_Bisley_data <- sm_Q3_Bisley_data |> mutate(Site_ID = "BQ3")
sm_PRM_data <- moving_average(PRM_data)
sm_PRM_data <- sm_PRM_data |> mutate(Site_ID = "PRM")

# Combine smoothed data from all 4 sites
combo_smooth_data <- rbind(
  sm_Q1_Bisley_data,
  sm_Q2_Bisley_data,
  sm_Q3_Bisley_data,
  sm_PRM_data
)
```

## Results

```{r}
# Pivot longer to create ion columns
smooth_data_longer <- combo_smooth_data |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = k_mgL:`nh4-n_ugL`,
    names_to = "Ion",
    values_to = "Mean_Concentration"
  )

# Visualization - Line Plot

# Line plot - ggplot2, facet_grid()
smooth_data_longer |>
  mutate(
    Ion = fct_recode(
      Ion,
      `K mgL` = "k_mgL",
      `NO3-N ugL` = "no3-n_ugL",
      `Mg mgL` = "mg_mgL",
      `Ca mgL` = "ca_mgL",
      `NH4-N ugL` = "nh4-n_ugL"
    ),
    Ion = fct_relevel(
      Ion,
      "K mgL",
      "NO3-N ugL",
      "Mg mgL",
      "Ca mgL",
      "NH4-N ugL"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(
    mapping = aes(
      x = window_start,
      y = Mean_Concentration,
      linetype = Site_ID
    )
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(), # Remove legend title
    axis.title.y = element_blank(), # Remove y axis title
    strip.placement = "outside", # Move y labels (ions) outside y ticks
    legend.position = c(1, 1), # Coordinates for the top-left corner inside the panel
    legend.justification = c(1, 1), # Anchor top-left of the legend box to the coordinate
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Years"
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    Ion ~ .,
    scales = "free_y", # Independent y-axis scales per grid
    switch = "y" # Move y ion labels to left side
  ) +
  scale_x_date(sec.axis = dup_axis()) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.Date("1989-09-01"),
    color = "black",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5
  )
```

Figure 2: Replicated version of Schaefer et al. (2000) Figure 3 generated for this project.

## References
